storyCards.headline: Suavemente: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Elvis Crespo's "Suavemente" reached #84 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Suavemente" (English: "Softly") is a song recorded and composed by Puerto Rican merengue singer Elvis Crespo on his first solo album, Suavemente, which followed his departure from Grupo Manía.

The song peaked at #84 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Suavemente was released in 1998.
